title: GTA 6's Leonida Keys: "Some of the Most Dangerous Waters in America" 🌊 #Shorts
description:
Rockstar describes the Leonida Keys as a tropical archipelago on the doorstep of "some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America." Trailer 2 shows boats and jet skis. The link to the real Florida Keys is the press/fan reading of the region.
Source: Rockstar Games (rockstargames.com/VI), Trailer 2.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
